subject: Learning Methods
title: Prior Knowledge and Comprehension
description: Learn Prior Knowledge and Comprehension in one minute.

hook.text: Two students read the same passage. The one with background knowledge understood twice as much despite equal reading.

buildup.text: Comprehension is not just decoding words. It means connecting new information to what you already know.

discovery.text: Schema theory: existing mental frameworks act as hooks for new information. More hooks mean faster understanding.

twist.text: This is why experts read technical papers faster than students. It isn't reading speed.

climax.text: Before reading something new, activate prior knowledge first. Ask: what do I already know about this topic?

punchline.text: What you already know determines what you can learn next.

quiz.question: Why do experts read technical papers faster than students?
options: They have practiced speed reading techniques
Their background knowledge provides mental hooks for new information
They skip sections that are not important
